challenge.method: Compare the language relationship to the compiler guide's statement about resemblance and its multiple generated-code targets.
challenge.results: The book describes a language-level parent. Its compiler guide's resemblance to Lua 5.3–5.4 and distinct minimum targets do not establish one edition as the identity target. The permanent target is the general Lua entity.

limitations: The relationship targets Lua as a language. It does not fix a single base Lua edition or propagate any Lua 5.4 claim.
